matching: Rules see the dialled/displayed number with spaces, '-', '.', '(', ')' removed and a leading '00' turned into '+'. 'national' = the 10 digits of an Indian number (+91XXXXXXXXXX, 0XXXXXXXXXX, 91XXXXXXXXXX or a bare 10-digit number). First matching rule wins, in the order listed.

label.en: Official service call (1600 number) from a bank, insurer, investment firm or government office
label.hi: बैंक, बीमा, निवेश कंपनी या सरकारी विभाग की आधिकारिक सेवा कॉल (1600 नंबर)

rules.note: 1600-ABC-XXX (ABC = licensed service area). TRAI: calls from the 1600 series may not be tagged, filtered or blocked. Never mark as spam; crowd reports are refused (422 PROTECTED_SERIES).

label.en: Registered promotional call (140 number). To stop these, use DND: call or SMS 1909.
label.hi: पंजीकृत प्रचार कॉल (140 नंबर)। इन्हें रोकने के लिए DND लें: 1909 पर कॉल या SMS करें।

rules.note: 140 series = promotional voice calls by registered senders, any sector. TRAI: not to be tagged or filtered except through the customer's DND preference. Crowd reports are refused (422 PROTECTED_SERIES).

label.en: Unusual number: an Indian number has 10 digits after +91
label.hi: असामान्य नंबर: भारतीय नंबर में +91 के बाद 10 अंक होते हैं

rules.note: +91 followed by more or fewer than 10 digits is not a real Indian number (often spoofed or a VoIP gateway).

label.hi: असामान्य लंबाई का नंबर - सावधान रहें

rules.note: An international (+) number with fewer than 8 or more than 15 digits.

label.en: Call from abroad ({code}) - government offices, banks and police never call you from a foreign number
label.hi: विदेश से कॉल ({code}) - सरकारी विभाग, बैंक और पुलिस कभी विदेशी नंबर से कॉल नहीं करते

rules.note: Country codes come from riskyCountryCodes (server configuration fraudshield.calls.risky-country-codes).

countryNotes.+92: DoT advisory (29 Mar 2024): WhatsApp calls from +92 numbers impersonating DoT / police, threatening disconnection or arrest

TRAI-DIR-2025-11-19.title: TRAI Direction of 19 Nov 2025: phased mandatory use of the 1600 series for service/transactional voice calls by RBI, SEBI, PFRDA and IRDAI regulated entities (from 1 Jan 2026)

TRAI-PR-91-2026.title: TRAI press release No. 91/2026 (Jul 2026): 1600 calls cannot be tagged, filtered or blocked; 140 is for promotional calls, blocked only by DND preference

DOT-1600-ALLOT-2025.title: DoT allotment of '1600' numbering series (format 1600-ABC-XXX per licensed service area), Jan 2025

TRAI-TCCCPR-2018.title: TRAI Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2018 (as amended): 140-series for promotional calls; DND via 1909

DOT-ADV-2024-03-29.title: DoT advisory, 29 Mar 2024: do not answer WhatsApp calls from foreign numbers such as +92 impersonating DoT; report on Sanchar Saathi / 1930

ITU-E164.title: ITU-T E.164: international numbers have at most 15 digits

DOT-NNP-2003.title: DoT National Numbering Plan: 10-digit national significant numbers in India
